id: \rHapu: Tapu Fini isn't here at the moment. In fact, you just missed it.
en: \rHapu: Tapu Fini isn't here at the moment. In fact, you just missed it.
it: \rHapu: Tapu Fini al momento non c'è. Anzi, l'hai appena mancato.

id: \rBut don't worry. As the brand new Island Kahuna, I'll accept your challenge right now.
en: \rBut don't worry. As the brand new Island Kahuna, I'll accept your challenge right now.
it: \rMa non preoccuparti. Come nuovissima Kahuna dell'isola, accetterò subito la tua sfida.

id: \rYou did it somehow. You can have this, a Steelium Z.
en: \rYou did it somehow. You can have this, a Steelium Z.
it: \rIn qualche modo ce l'hai fatta. Tieni, un Metallium Z.

id: \rWith that you can power up your Steel-type attacks.
en: \rWith that you can power up your Steel-type attacks.
it: \rCon quello puoi potenziare le mosse di tipo Acciaio.

id: Rotom Dex: You're the last person to finish their assignment. Let's go back home now.
en: Rotom Dex: You're the last person to finish their assignment. Let's go back home now.
it: Rotom Dex: Sei l'ultimo a finire il proprio compito. Torniamo a casa ora.

id: \rHapu: It's good to finally be the Island Kahuna.
en: \rHapu: It's good to finally be the Island Kahuna.
it: \rHapu: È bello essere finalmente la Kahuna dell'isola.
